l.x: Riverpaw Gnolls and Scouts (level 11-13) roam the hills south of the coast, from above Jangolode Mine east to the The Jansen Stead. The gnolls further south and west are 13-19: stay in the north hills. Murloc Coastrunners and Raiders line the beach north of the mine. They flee at low health: pull one at a time. Careful: Gnolls that stand close together tend to join a fight as a group. Pulling one at a time is safer. Careful: Two Defias stand guard inside the house, one of them the level 15 named Benny Blaanco. They are linked, so attacking either one brings both.
